items.exampleEn: My grandmother cleans the windows with water and white vinegar.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶用水和白醋擦窗戶。

items.exampleEn: The peach trees in the valley bloom with pink flowers in spring.
items.exampleZh: 春天時，山谷裡的桃樹開滿粉紅色的花。

items.exampleEn: A bright red cherry sat on top of the cake.
items.exampleZh: 一顆鮮紅的櫻桃放在蛋糕頂端。

items.exampleEn: Berries like strawberries are easy to freeze and keep for months.
items.exampleZh: 像草莓這類莓果很容易冷凍，可以放好幾個月。

items.exampleEn: The children carved funny faces into their pumpkins.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在南瓜上刻出好笑的臉。

items.exampleEn: Olive trees can live for hundreds of years.
items.exampleZh: 橄欖樹可以活好幾百年。

items.exampleEn: On the island, we drank fresh coconut water straight from the shell.
items.exampleZh: 在島上，我們直接從殼裡喝新鮮的椰子水。

items.exampleEn: We roasted some squash with olive oil for dinner.
items.exampleZh: 我們晚餐用橄欖油烤了一些南瓜。

items.sentenceEn: Add a little vinegar to the sauce to give it a sharp taste.
items.sentenceZh: 在醬汁裡加一點醋，讓它帶點酸味。

items.audioEn: The market sells peaches and cherries only in early summer, so buy them now.
items.audioZh: 市場只有初夏才賣桃子和櫻桃，所以現在就買吧。
items.questionZh: 市場什麼時候賣桃子和櫻桃？
options: At any time of the year

items.sentenceEn: We picked wild berries along the path and ate them right away.
items.sentenceZh: 我們沿著小路摘野莓，馬上就吃掉了。

items.sentenceEn: Twenty people squashed into the tiny elevator.
items.sentenceZh: 二十個人擠進那部小小的電梯。

items.stemEn: Mix the ____ oil with lemon juice to make a light salad dressing.
items.stemZh: 把橄欖油和檸檬汁混合，做成清爽的沙拉醬。

items.stemEn: This curry is cooked with ____ milk, which makes it sweet and rich.
items.stemZh: 這道咖哩是用椰奶煮的，所以吃起來甜甜的、味道香濃。

items.passageEn: Every autumn, our town holds a harvest festival. Farmers bring huge orange pumpkins and other kinds of squash to show off their size. One stand sells jam that a local family makes from peaches, cherries and wild berries. Another sells olives in jars of vinegar and herbs, packed in cardboard boxes. My favorite is a small stall selling coconut cake. The streets get so crowded that people are squashed together, but nobody seems to mind. At the end of the day, there is a contest for the biggest pumpkin. Last year's winner weighed over three hundred kilos!
items.passageZh: 每年秋天，我們鎮上都會舉辦豐收節。農夫們帶來巨大的橘色南瓜和其他各種瓜類，展示它們有多大。有個攤位賣當地一戶人家用桃子、櫻桃和野莓做的果醬。另一個攤位賣泡在醋和香草裡的罐裝橄欖，裝在紙箱裡。我最喜歡的是一個賣椰子蛋糕的小攤。街上擠到大家都被擠在一起，但似乎沒有人介意。一天結束時，還有最大南瓜比賽。去年的冠軍超過三百公斤！

options: 泡在醋和香草裡的罐裝
和桃子一起做成果醬來賣

questions.questionZh: 豐收節最後有什麼活動？

items.promptZh: 小心別把袋子裡的桃子壓扁了。
referenceEn: Be careful not to squash the peaches in the bag.
Try not to squash the peaches in the bag.
rubricZh: squash 當動詞是「壓扁」（例如 squash the peaches）
「小心別」可寫 be careful not to…、try not to… 等

items.instructionZh: 用 berry 造一個句子，說說你喜歡怎麼吃莓果。
referenceEn: I like to put fresh berries on my yogurt in the morning.
My favorite dessert is a cake covered with mixed berries.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 berry 或 berries（例如 fresh berries）
